info.title: Webby.RoomService
info.description: This API provides endpoints for managing rooms and categories.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of room categories. Supports optional search by name.

post.description: Create a new room category. Name is required (2-50 chars, unique). Only administrators can perform this action.

put.description: Update an existing room category by ID. Only the name field is updateable. Only administrators can perform this action.

delete.description: Delete a room category by ID. Permanent action. Only administrators can perform this action.

post.description: Create a new room with a name, category ID, privacy setting, and optional thumbnail.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all rooms created by the authenticated user. Returns both public and private rooms.
Retrieve a paginated list of all publicly visible rooms. Supports optional search and category filter.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category ID (UUID v4 format)

schema.description: Filter by category ID (UUID v4 format)

400.description: Invalid request body or missing token

404.description: Room with given token not found

post.summary: Get a room by invite token
post.description: Retrieve room information using its unique invite token. Token is required and cannot be empty.

get.description: Retrieve a room by its ID. Only the room creator (host) can retrieve the room by ID.

put.description: Update a room's name, category ID, privacy setting, and thumbnail by ID. Only the authorized room creator can update.

delete.description: Delete a room by ID. Permanent action - cannot be undone. Only the authorized room creator can delete.

400.description: Invalid UUID format or query parameters

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of members for a specific room. Supports optional search by username.

403.description: Not authorized - only host can remove members

delete.summary: Remove a member from a room
delete.description: Remove a user from a room's member list. Only the room host can remove members. The host cannot remove themselves.

get.description: Retrieve the playback queue for a room with enriched media data. Pagination is based on individual videos. Only room members can view the queue.

403.description: Access denied - only room members can add to queue

post.description: Add a video or playlist to the room's playback queue. Only room members can add items.

delete.description: Remove a video or playlist from the room's playback queue. Only room members can remove. Only standalone videos or playlists can be deleted, not individual playlist children.
